description: Read one canonical job instruction page as rich TipTap JSON. By default this is the employer's DRAFT (preserve its checksum for safe patch/replace writes), which workers may not see yet. Pass released: true to read the page exactly as workers see it (the job's released Instructions; Google Doc pages live): write quiz questions grounded with opentrain_quiz_grounding_snapshot from this text, never the draft; its content.checksum equals the pinned one. A job with nothing released answers 409 INSTRUCTIONS_NOT_RELEASED; a page that is not released (draft only) answers 404 PAGE_NOT_RELEASED. Requires instructions:read.

released.description: true = the page as workers see it (released Instructions; result.source: released). Default false: the employer draft.

name: opentrain_job_instructions_read_page
